messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

The kettle’s refund is the amount you paid for it after any discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping is not refunded automatically; if you request a shipping refund, a staff member takes the case (refund-policy/v2/shipping).
